decisions.reason: Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D specify HVAC calculation methods; they do not change the existing requirement to perform all required electrical calculations.
The HVAC calculation methods do not alter the permit-ready electrical drawing deliverable, whose creation was separately reaffirmed in the same message.
Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D support HVAC design calculations but do not change the existing mechanical drawing deliverable.
The specified HVAC calculation methods do not affect the permit-ready plumbing drawing deliverable.
The HVAC calculation-method clarification does not change the existing requirement for electrical PE endorsement of the electrical drawings.
